arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: *with a wry smile* A delivery from Serene? I swear she thinks I live on bread and stubbornness.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: Sensible woman. I was nearly out. Come in, Caelan.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: *sighs* Trying to. I put the lantern safely out of the way, and now I can’t reach the wretched thing.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: Yes. The stool’s beneath the shelf. Would you fetch it for me?

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: Gently, mind. I’ve got enough to mend without giving myself another job.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: *looks over the lantern* Thank you. I can clean it here.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: You’re carrying this one for your husband again?

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: I am. He used to say he only came to the Festival of Light to hear me sing.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: *laughs* The old liar couldn’t carry a tune himself. Never stopped him joining in.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: *her smile softens* Parts of it, perhaps. I still turn to tell him things. Then I remember.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: *after a quiet moment* But remembering him isn’t the same as losing him again. There’s plenty I’m glad to remember.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: So am I. And you’ll be there?

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: Good. Tell Serene I’ll bring the lantern myself. She’s done enough carrying things for me today.

reminder.speaker: elira
reminder.text: The stool is just beneath the shelf. Take your time with the lantern.

carrying.speaker: elira
carrying.text: You can set it on the table. Thank you for fetching it.

after.speaker: elira
after.text: I’ll bring the lantern myself. Thank Serene for me, won’t you?
